info.title: Pontiac API
info.description: The JSON API behind the React UI. Routes, parameters and — for endpoints that return a response DTO — the response shapes.

get.summary:
The free slots for a session of a plan (?planId=) or of a plan someone has (?enrollmentId=), or to move a
session (?sessionId=: its own time counts as free), grouped by day.
?q= searches the name; ?includeInactive=1 shows disabled ones too.
Every category, for pickers (active first; a disabled one still shows where it is used).

delete.summary: Not offered for new pages and contacts; the contacts that have it keep it.

get.summary: Every file of theirs, turned-off ones too, newest first.

post.summary: Multipart: `file`, and `shared` ("1": the client sees it).

get.summary: ?q= searches name, email and phone; ?status=, ?category= (an id, or "none") and ?sourcePage= (an id) narrow it.

patch.summary: {categoryId}: one of the consultant's categories, or null for none.

post.summary:
Ley 1581, on the person's request: their name, email, phone and answers are erased for good. Only the owner, who
answers for the data, can do it.
"Asignar plan": a free one starts at once; a paid one waits for its payment and emails the link.
Only a plan still waiting for its payment.
Money received outside Wompi (cash, a transfer): the plan starts and the person becomes a client.
"Renovar": the used-up plan is closed and another one starts (a paid one sends its payment link).
"Finalizar asesoría": the used-up plan is closed and the person is finished (paying again brings them back).

get.summary: ?q= searches file name and alt text; ?includeInactive=1 shows disabled ones too.

post.summary: multipart/form-data: "file", and optionally "altText".

delete.summary: No longer offered for new content; pages that show it keep showing it.

get.summary: ?q= searches title and address; ?status= and ?template= narrow it.
The templates, their sections and fields: what the editor draws.

patch.summary: Saves title, address and draft; visitors see nothing of it until it is published.

post.summary:
The editor's live preview: a draft (not saved) as visitors would see it. HTML, for an iframe's srcdoc; a draft
that is not valid yet answers the 422 the save would.
Takes it down: visitors get a 410, search engines drop it. Its content is kept.
Makes it the page at /<consultant>.

get.summary: ?q= searches the person's name and email and the reference; ?status=; ?from= and ?to= (Y-m-d, local days, inclusive).
?q= searches name and description; ?includeInactive=1 shows disabled ones too.
Every plan, for pickers (active first).

put.summary: Enrollments keep the name, price and sessions they were made with: a change applies from now on.

delete.summary: No longer offered: pages stop booking it; enrollments already made keep their sessions.

put.summary: The owner answers for the data (Ley 1581): only they change it. Empty goes back to the platform's text.

get.summary: ?q= searches the contact's name and email; ?status=; ?from= and ?to= (Y-m-d, local days, inclusive).

post.summary:
The consultant books a session for a contact: on a plan they have with sessions left (`enrollmentId`), or on an
active free plan (`planId`, a new enrollment).

get.summary: The scheduled sessions of the week that starts on ?start= (Y-m-d, local; this week's Monday by default).

post.summary: Undoes "done" or "no-show" marked by mistake.

get.summary: ?q= searches name and email.

post.summary: Invites an assistant: they get an email to set their password.
A new invitation link, for someone who has not set their password yet.

delete.summary: Disables an assistant: they are signed out at their next request. Nothing is deleted.

post.summary: "Probar conexión": does Wompi know the public key?
Always 204, whether the email has an account or not.
"Mi cuenta › Cambiar contraseña".

get.summary: ?q= searches name, address and owner's email; ?status= "active" or "suspended".

post.summary: A new consultant: the account with the platform's defaults, and its owner, invited by email.

patch.summary: Datos, and Límites y funciones. A field left out is left as it is.

post.summary: Its people cannot sign in and its public pages are not served, until it is reactivated. Nothing is deleted.

get.summary: The owner and the assistants. ?q= searches name and email. Clients are the consultant's, not listed here.

delete.summary: Disables an assistant. The owner is not disabled: suspend the consultant instead.

post.summary: The super admin may enable an assistant beyond the consultant's limit: the limit binds the consultant.

get.summary: ?q= searches name and email.

delete.summary: Never yourself: the platform always keeps the person doing this.

get.summary: ?q= searches recipient, subject and consultant; ?status= "sent" or "failed"; ?account= a consultant's id.

post.summary: Sent at once, not queued: the super admin waits to see whether the mail server takes it (502 email_failed).

patch.summary: A field left out is left as it is; the change is logged (Historial).

get.summary: Newest first; ?q= searches who changed it and the settings' names.

post.summary: Multipart `file`: theirs, so the consultant sees it and so do they.
"Pagar": Wompi's checkout for a plan waiting for its payment; Wompi brings them back to the result page.

get.summary: Every session of theirs, the latest first.
The free slots for a session of one of their plans (?enrollmentId=), or to move one (?sessionId=).

reminderHours.title: hours before a session, largest first

startsAt.title: ISO 8601 (UTC): what to send back to book it.

shared.title: The client sees it (always true for what they uploaded).

byClient.title: Uploaded by the client, from the portal.

sourcePage.title: The page that brought them first.

anonymized.title: Their data was erased on request (Ley 1581).

planName.title: The plan's name as it was when they enrolled.

method.title: Wompi's (CARD, PSE, NEQUI, …) or a manual one (cash, transfer, other).

paymentUrl.title: The link to pay it, while it waits for a payment.

consentAt.title: ISO 8601: when they last accepted the privacy policy.

sessionsToday.title: Scheduled sessions today and tomorrow, in the consultant's timezone.

paymentsLast7Days.title: Approved payments in the last 7 days: how many and how much.

sizeBytes.title: The original and its copies, what counts towards storage.

path.title: Where visitors find it: /<consultant> for the home page, /<consultant>/<slug> for the rest.

hasUnpublishedChanges.title: The draft differs from what visitors see.

fields.title: for "items": the fields of each item

color.title: Its main colour, for the picker's swatch.

fieldTypes.title: the types an extra form field can have

free.title: Price zero: booked straight from a page.

text.title: What the forms link to: the consultant's text, or the platform's default when they have none.

editable.title: Whether the person asking may change it (its author, or the owner).

loginStatus.title: "active" (has a password), "invited" (link sent, not used yet) or "none".

lastSignInAt.title: ISO 8601; null until they first sign in.

mode.title: "test" or "production", from the keys; null until there is a public key.

configured.title: Enough to take payments: public key, events and integrity secrets.

eventsUrl.title: What to paste in Wompi's dashboard as the events URL.

accountSlug.title: A client signs in at /<slug>/portal; null for a super admin.

slug.title: The first segment of its public URLs: /<slug>, /<slug>/portal.

features.title: the features that are on: the UI hides the menus of the others

account.title: The consultant's account; null for a super admin.

uiTheme.title: The person at the screen's own theme: the super admin's while they act as someone.

impersonator.title: null unless a super admin is acting as this user

loginPath.title: Where they sign in now: "/login" or "/<consultant>/portal/ingresar".

lastSignInAt.title: ISO 8601; null until they first sign in.

owner.title: null only for an account created before owners were invited with it.

lastSignInAt.title: ISO 8601; null until they first sign in.

you.title: The super admin reading the list: they cannot disable themselves.

failedEmailsLast7Days.title: Attempts to send an email that failed in the last 7 days.

failedJobs.title: Queue messages that failed every retry and wait in the "failed" queue.

error.title: Why it failed, as the mail server said it; null when sent.

account.title: The consultant it was sent for; null for the platform's own emails.

enabledTemplates.title: PageTemplate values a new page may use

reminderHours.title: hours before a session, largest first

updatedAt.title: ISO 8601; null until a super admin first saves them.

canChange.title: Before the consultant's cancellation limit: they may move or cancel it.

manual.title: Recorded by the consultant (cash, transfer): known by its day only.

payable.title: Waiting for payment, and the consultant takes online payments.

plans.title: active and waiting for payment, newest first

cancelHours.title: Hours before a session until which they may move or cancel it.
